meta.name: Grapher semantic integrity and immutable status transitions
meta.description: Portable architecture record for tamper-evident semantic assertions and append-only status interpretation changes.

decision-semantic-integrity-status-trans.title: Represent truth-status changes as immutable hash-linked graph records
decision-semantic-integrity-status-trans.content: {"decision": "Epistemic status changes are represented by immutable hash-linked status-transition child records rather than unjournaled rewrites of the originating semantic assertion. Existing typed content and rationale remain the thesis-bearing fields; no duplicate descriptor field is added.", "rationale": "The graph must permit classification to evolve while preserving what a record originally asserted. Hashing the assertion and recording each later classification as a separately finalized child makes mutation accountable, tamper-evident, attributable, and transferable between Grapher workspaces."}

semantic.decision: Epistemic status changes are represented by immutable hash-linked status-transition child records rather than unjournaled rewrites of the originating semantic assertion. Existing typed content and rationale remain the thesis-bearing fields; no duplicate descriptor field is added.
semantic.rationale: The graph must permit classification to evolve while preserving what a record originally asserted. Hashing the assertion and recording each later classification as a separately finalized child makes mutation accountable, tamper-evident, attributable, and transferable between Grapher workspaces.

implementation-semantic-integrity-status.title: Add semantic SHA-256 identity and status-transition materialization
implementation-semantic-integrity-status.content: {"change": "Add the grapher-semantic-v1 SHA-256 assertion hash, finalized status_transition child records at the canonical save boundary, a status_changed_by relation, integrity validation helpers, and a synchronized legacy status cache. Exclude local node IDs from semantic hashing so prefixed graph transfers preserve assertion identity.", "component": "grapher integrity, semantic registry, curation, persistence, validation, and tests"}

semantic.change: Add the grapher-semantic-v1 SHA-256 assertion hash, finalized status_transition child records at the canonical save boundary, a status_changed_by relation, integrity validation helpers, and a synchronized legacy status cache. Exclude local node IDs from semantic hashing so prefixed graph transfers preserve assertion identity.
semantic.component: grapher integrity, semantic registry, curation, persistence, validation, and tests

edges.note: Implementation realizes the accepted semantic-integrity architecture.
